applicableAreas: Building 1 through Building 8 footprints
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows building footprints and underground electric line routing but contains no explicit dimensions, callouts, or notes documenting that building foundations maintain minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from underground electric facilities (duct banks, conduit, pull boxes, manholes). Clearance compliance cannot be verified from submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls around site perimeter and adjacent to buildings
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on site plan and grading plan. Sheet 21 shows underground electric routing but does not document clearance distances from electric facilities to permanent structures. No dimensions or callouts verify 5-foot clearance from duct banks to retaining walls or other permanent site structures.

applicableAreas: Street right-of-way and site perimeter
findings.comment: Streetlight infrastructure is not clearly depicted or addressed on the electrical plan. If streetlights are proposed (standard for development), their conduit routing and clearance from building foundations cannot be verified from the submitted site plan documents.

applicableAreas: Hardscape features, walkways, and parking areas throughout site
findings.comment: Site plan shows proposed driveways, walkways, and hardscape features, and Sheet 21 shows underground electric routing. However, no dimensions or engineer callouts document verification that courtyard areas, hardscape features, and site improvements maintain required clearances from underground electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Storm drainage system with catch basins and grate inlets
findings.comment: Storm sewer plan shows drain inlet locations, and Sheet 21 shows underground electric routing. However, no dimensions or coordination notes document verification that proposed drain inlets maintain required clearances from underground electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Locations where water lines and electric conduit routing overlap or cross
findings.comment: Water lines and underground electric are both shown on Site Plans and utility sheets. However, no utility profile sheets or horizontal separation dimensions document that electric conduit maintains minimum 12-inch horizontal clearance from water lines when crossing perpendicularly.

applicableAreas: Locations where wastewater lines and electric conduit routing overlap or cross
findings.comment: Wastewater lines and underground electric are both present. However, no utility profile sheets or horizontal separation dimensions document that electric conduit maintains minimum 12-inch horizontal clearance from wastewater lines when crossing perpendicularly.

applicableAreas: Areas where multiple utilities (electric, communications, reclaimed water) are routed
findings.comment: Utility plans show electric, water, wastewater, communications, and storm drain routing. However, no dimensions or coordination notes document verification that electric conduit maintains minimum 12-inch horizontal clearance from other private utilities (communications, reclaimed water) when crossing perpendicularly.

applicableAreas: Utility crossing points between water/wastewater lines and underground electric
findings.comment: Water and wastewater utilities cross underground electric on the site. However, submitted utility profile sheets (Sheet 20) show water line details but do not document vertical separation at crossing points with underground electric. Minimum 12-inch vertical clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Street right-of-way utility tap connection
findings.comment: Sheet 20 shows utility tap in public right-of-way. However, no plan dimensions document that proposed duct bank within right-of-way maintains minimum 10-foot clearance from centerline or verify compliance with ROW utility placement standards.

applicableAreas: Areas with adjacent overhead electric distribution lines
findings.comment: Site plan and electrical plan show overhead electric lines adjacent to the property. However, no utility profile sheets or depth documentation verify that proposed underground utilities beneath aerial electric easements maintain adequate depth to sustain required overhead conductor clearances per UCM § 1.10.3 (7.5 feet minimum from overhead primary/secondary conductors).

applicableAreas: Property boundaries where adjacent parcels have overhead electric
findings.comment: Adjacent properties show overhead electric distribution lines, and proposed underground electric is shown on Sheet 21. However, no dimensions or separation callouts document that proposed underground electric lines maintain minimum 10-foot separation from overhead electric lines on adjacent properties.

applicableAreas: All utility corridors where Austin Water and non-Austin Water utilities are routed
findings.comment: Utility plans show Austin Water infrastructure (water, wastewater) and non-Austin Water utilities (electric, communications) routed in proximity. However, no plan dimensions document that minimum 5-foot horizontal separation is maintained between Austin Water infrastructure and all other non-Austin Water utilities for trench integrity, or document applicable 3-foot residential exception if applicable.

applicableAreas: Parking areas with utility infrastructure
findings.comment: Site plan shows parking layout and storm sewer plan shows manhole locations. However, no dimensions or conflict resolution notes document whether any storm drain or sanitary sewer manholes are located directly beneath parallel parking spaces or document mitigation if conflicts exist.

applicableAreas: Driveway and internal utility corridors
findings.comment: Utility plans show both wet utilities (water, wastewater) and dry utilities (electric, communications) routed through site. However, no notes or plan annotations document whether wet utilities are grouped and alternated separately from dry utilities for safety purposes, or confirm that this grouping/alternation requirement has been considered and applied.

applicableAreas: Storm drain manhole locations relative to site features
findings.comment: Site plan shows stairs, ramps, and ADA accessible routes, and storm sewer plan shows manhole locations. However, no plan notes or conflict resolution documentation verify that manhole placement does not conflict with proposed site feature requirements or document resolution if conflicts exist.

applicableAreas: Underground electric duct bank locations
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows underground electric routing and Sheet 11 shows grading and finished surface elevations. However, no utility profile sheets or elevation callouts document actual cover depths over duct banks or verify compliance with minimum 36-inch cover requirement.

applicableAreas: Building footprints (Buildings 1-8)
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows building footprints and underground electric line routing. However, there is no documentation verifying that building foundations and structures are NOT installed over Austin Energy underground facilities. No engineer notes or dimensions confirm clearance from building footprints to underground electric lines or demonstrate compliance with prohibition on structures over underground facilities.

applicableAreas: Areas where communications conduit and underground electric routing intersect
findings.comment: Utility plans show both communications conduit and underground electric routing. However, no plan annotations or profile details verify that communication conduits are not positioned over AE main line duct banks, which is prohibited per UCM § 1.10.5.A. Routing relationship cannot be confirmed from submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Utility crossing points where AE conduit crosses other utilities
findings.comment: Utility plans and profiles show various utility crossings. However, no detail sheets or profile annotations document whether AE conduit crossings are provided with required 2-inch concrete encasement extending minimum 24 inches on either side of crossing point, or whether coordination with AE Design regarding encasement requirements has occurred.

applicableAreas: Retaining wall locations where underground electric may pass through
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on site plan and grading plan. However, no plan notes, details, or documentation verify whether electric conduit passes through retaining walls below grade or confirm that required license agreement, metal sleeve, perpendicular passage with one-inch extension, and PE-sealed engineering drawings are in place if applicable.

applicableAreas: Fire demand meter vault in public right-of-way
findings.comment: Sheet 20 shows an 8' x 12' fire demand meter vault in the public right-of-way. However, no plan dimensions or coordination notes document that the vault maintains required 5-foot exclusive space around and under the vault structure, or verify that no other underground utilities or structures encroach within the exclusive zone per UCM § 2.9.1.A.4.

applicableAreas: Building exterior walls where electrical meters are mounted
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows electrical meter locations mounted on building exterior walls (north, east, and south walls). However, no elevation details or architectural callouts document that meters are NOT located on/under porches, stairways, under overhangs exceeding 72 inches, carports, or areas where moving objects might damage equipment per UCM § 1.9.3.1.

applicableAreas: Building exterior walls where electrical meters and transformers are located
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows meter and transformer locations. However, no elevation details or building plans document that electric meters are located on first floor or ground level, or verify that meters are within sight of Austin Energy transformers and meet visual line-of-sight requirements per UCM § 1.9.3.1.

applicableAreas: Building electrical distribution
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows meter locations. However, no electrical single-line diagrams, building electrical plans, or distance documentation verify that distance between electric meter and main disconnect does not exceed 20 feet or confirm that meter and disconnect are within line of sight per UCM § 1.9.3.1.
